notes: Search engines surfaced almost nothing Baltic until results were restricted to .lt/.lv/.ee domains. No food-truck / market pre-order tool with customer online ordering was found in any of the three countries (CompuCash LV has a food-truck till page but takes takeaway orders only via Bolt/Wolt). Choice answered 403 on /ee, /lv and /lt pricing (one try each); an Estonian café's own pre-order page (akadeemiakohv.ee/delivery/pages/preorder) redirects to akadeemia-kohv.choiceqr.com, so Choice is in use in Estonia, but that is not the vendor's site and no price could be confirmed. EE: SumUp (generic web shop, weak) and Poster (food-truck page + Estonia representative page, but English-only and USD prices, add-on website for takeout; weak). Tellikohe and Kassahaldus (EE) could not be read (JS-rendered / empty). LV: only SumUp (generic web shop with in-store pickup) is eligible; Latvian tills checked (MEALS, CompuCash, NRdata, PapaPos) show no customer online ordering. LT: Refektorius (weekly fee 7 €/sav. + 2–5% commission, period 'week' kept as stated) and ared (20 € per till per month + PVM, pickup at an agreed time) are genuine local café/restaurant tools; SumUp as the till fallback. Zettle not checked: no Baltic site is known and SumUp already covers the till fallback.
